<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 262.099 ≈ [M+H]⁺) and subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~261.092 Da. Solving 12·C + 1.007825·H + 15.994915·O = 261.092 yields the integer solution C₁₈H₁₃O₂, which matches the observed mass within <1 ppm. Therefore the molecular formula of the molecule in the sample is C18H13O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H13O2</final_answer>
